description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to appoint Prof. Ranjith Premalal De Silva to be the Competent Authority of the Trincomalee Campus w.e.f. 15.01.2015
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Prof. Rajiva Wijesinha, Minister of Higher Education) and detailed descriptions of government responsibilities/portfolios (exercising powers under the Universities Act, appointing a Competent Authority with specific functions to manage the Trincomalee Campus). The content includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
